notes:
From English "sponge." In Japanese, スポンジ most commonly refers to the kitchen or cleaning sponge, though it also applies to sponge material in general (e.g., sponge cake).

- ⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧⟦{洗|あら}い→洗う：00827_arau⟧⟦{用|よう}→用：09842_you⟧スポンジ (dish sponge)
- お⟦{風呂|ふろ}→風呂：14633_furo⟧⟦{用|よう}→用：09842_you⟧スポンジ (bath sponge)
- ⟦{化粧|けしょう}→化粧：02699_keshou⟧スポンジ (makeup sponge)
- ⟦メラミンスポンジ→メラミンスポンジ：noentry⟧ (melamine sponge, "magic eraser")
